700.author: qingkwl
700.body:
## Summary

Adds the JiuwenSwarm startup-latency work as **one consolidated patch** (`0010-jw-startup-latency.patch`, ~35s of per-launch savings). The changes were developed and measured on the Windows desktop line (same-machine A/B against gateway startup stage logs):

| change | measured saving |
|---|---|
| feishu SDK lazy import (it was imported even with the channel disabled) | ~4.7s |
| `tui_connect` preload off the critical path | ~1.8s |
| channel-config settle window 0.75s -> 0.2s | ~0.55s |
| heartbeat import chain deferred | ~2.8s |
| AgentServer import slimming (pandas/pdfplumber/milvus out of the import path) | ~6.8s |
| Gateway<->AgentServer connect unblocked from warmup | ~9.5s |
| post-listen warmups gated behind the first request | ~15.6s |

End-to-end on the Windows desktop: warm restart ~17.5s -> ~5-7s; user-perceived cold start 50s+ -> 20-25s.

**Why one patch instead of seven**: the changes overlap on `app_gateway.py` / `agent_ws_server.py`, and a chain where several patches edit the same region cannot pass the idempotent-reapply contract (`swarm-patches.py apply` twice must be a no-op — the `--reverse --check` skip needs each patch's post-state intact). Consolidating keeps one patch per file region, matching the upstream patch-set convention.

## Test plan

- [x] `swarm-patches.py apply` on a clean `workswarm0.2.6` checkout with 0001-0009 + this patch — passes
- [x] **second `apply` over the already-patched tree — no-op (the previously failing idempotency case)**
- [x] `swarm-patches.py verify` — passes
- [ ] CI green
700.head: jw-perf-patches
700.title: perf(jiuwenswarm): consolidated startup latency patch (lazy imports, warmup gating)

702.author: nanzhaogang
702.body:
## What
- Fold the learning path into one install page and one end-to-end walkthrough; drop the six single-step getting-started pages and the installer walkthrough with its screenshots.
- Add the Linux single-file install path: glibc aarch64/x86_64 build, Bubblewrap requirement, startup commands, common options, SSH port forwarding, and sandbox/token troubleshooting.
- Shorten the core and domain page titles. Sidebar labels are taken from each page's H1, so the long descriptive titles made the navigation unwieldy.
- Link `plant-growth.csv` where the walkthrough asks readers to upload it, and rename two headings that promised more than the step delivers.

## Why
The old getting-started group asked readers to pick among six short pages before they had seen the product work. One install page plus one walkthrough exercises Agent loops, tools, Skills, Specialists, workspaces and artifacts in a single pass, and the Linux path is now documented next to Windows.

## Checks
- Built the docs site and ran its link check: 120 doc pages, 129 pages and 6434 local links verified.
- Branch is based on `9191d552`; the fork is ~272 commits behind `main`, so a rebase or merge may be needed before merging.
